service.name: Детско тържество · пакет за 10 деца
service.description: За деца на 1–12 г. Храна и напитка за 10 деца, поднасяне на тортата. Доп. дете: 20 €. Внесена торта: 20 €; включена торта не е посочена. Невъзстановимо капаро 51,13 €. След уточняване се плащат 50% от стойността; уточнете отчитането на капарото. Заявки и промени най-късно 3 дни преди партито.
service.descriptionEn: Ages 1–12. Food and a drink for 10 children, and cake serving. Extra child: €20. Bringing a cake: €20; the package does not list a cake. Non-refundable €51.13 deposit. Once the order is agreed, 50% is payable; ask how the deposit counts. Requests and changes at least 3 days before the party.
service.qualifications: The regular EUR 300 package lists meals and drinks for ten children and ceremonial cake serving. Generic birthday conditions specify a two-hour party, a EUR 20 charge per additional child and a EUR 20 outside-cake fee. A cake, entertainer, exclusive hall and any particular indoor/outdoor section are not represented as included. The owner distinguishes a EUR 51.13 non-refundable deposit from a 50 percent advance once the order is agreed; the effect of the former on the latter is not stated. Requests and changes must be made at least three days before the event.
